meta.task: Design a battery for a hybrid electric vehicle: energy density >= 327.18 Wh/kg, 4C fast charge without lithium plating, SEI <= 550 nm after 100 cycles at 45C, nail penetration (10 W short-circuit heat generation) without triggering thermal runaway

goal_parse.4c_charge_plating: plated == false (4C charge at 45C per protocol 4C_charge_45C)

meta.base_reason: task text names no electrode system -> default Chen2020 per anchor table (NMC811/graphite); aging-capable (has SEI kinetics); plating/thermal defaults injected by run-pyamm where missing (recorded via injected_defaults)

freedoms.thermal_management: adjustable (cooling h in PyBaMM; hA in run-tr nail scenario)

objective_breakdown: stage2: ED>=327.18 Wh/kg (calc-energy) + SEI<=550nm after 100cyc@45C (aging_1C_100cyc_45C); stage3: no Li plating at 4C charge 45C (plated=false via anode_potential_v) + nail 10W no thermal runaway (triggered=false). Central ED-vs-plating trade-off; SEI and nail decouple via coating bridge and cooling design respectively.
candidate_strategy: R1 baseline Chen2020 (no overrides) + opening ceiling assessment -> escalate to Stage 2 system candidate (OKane2022 SiOx / LNMO) if ceiling < 327.18. R2+ architecture/formulation variants (thickness/porosity/NP/separator/CC/particle radius/sigma,t+), 2-4 per round; SEI via coating bridge k_SEI x0.1-0.5 on same-system aging; nail via run-tr hA sweep with --mass-kg from calc-energy.
budget_allocation: R1 baseline+ceiling (5 sims); R2-R6 ED+plating ~2-3 variants/round SPMe (DFN finalists); R7-R9 SEI coating + aging; R10 nail hA sweep + final verification round (SPMe+DFN); deliverables + render + verify after achievement.
risk_and_fallback: ED ceiling short -> Stage 2 system switch; plating persists -> Stage 3 microstructure/transport levers then 3-strike boundary questioning; SEI>550 -> coating bridge; nail triggered -> raise hA, find min passing value, design cooling to it; artifacts annotated honestly (capacity-climb, Chen2020 discharged initial state); injected thermal defaults marked approximate; unimprovable -> quantified negative result, never threshold relaxation.

Mechanism focus: anode surface potential at separator interface = phi_s - phi_e — local electrolyte potential rise (ohmic through separator) directly depresses it; hence amplified electrolyte transport levers (sigma 2.0 / t+ 0.6 / D_e 6e-10) + finer anode particles (2.0 um) + decomposition of the neg-thickness term. All overrides declared pre-run: electrolyte values = formulation estimates (literature-typical single-ion/boosted liquid electrolyte, marked estimate).
